paragraphs: I'm Swar - a 20-year-old developer from Navi Mumbai who turns ambitious ideas into software people actually open every day.
I ship. A 3D space telemetry dashboard that pulls NASA, SpaceX and ISRO into one view, and a campus system used by 500+ people daily.
I also teach - breaking the MERN stack into small, practical videos so the next developer gets there faster.
Outside the IDE, you'll find me at the table-tennis table or sketching interface ideas in a notebook.
